title: The first band at Puclos
summary: The O'Neil Lavish band at Puclos was a small group of five: violin, piano, tenor banjo, saxophone and trumpet.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: I was going to ask some more about that very first band you played in at Puclos. Who else was in the band, the leader and all?
The O'Neil Lavish here, a violin player. And, let's see. And what did you play, by the way? I was playing the tenor banjo. Tenor banjo.
Yeah, tenor banjo. And, uh, saxophone and trumpet. And he was just a small group of strings?
Only a small band of five pieces. And there were three other bands we had there playing with us. I can't remember them just now. You remember the other instruments?
We had piano, we had violin, and tenor banjo, and saxophone and trumpet.
